technique_name: Explain what is a relu activation function,
description: A ReLU activation function (Rectified Linear Unit) is a type of mathematical decision-making unit used in Artificial Neural Networks. It is a piecewise linear function that calculates the output of a given input node by mapping it to 0 if it is less than 0 or to a positive value otherwise. The ReLU activation function is one of the most commonly used activation functions for deep learning applications due to its simplicity and computational efficiency.
